release.summary: Chapter painting coordinator refactor, no change in behaviour. The waits a verse sits out and what the route's final answer means moved out of paintItem into src/lib/bulk-answer.ts (sendWaitingOutRefusals, readVerseAnswer and its VerseAnswer outcome); paintItem switches on the outcome. The seven recovery refs (Pause and Stop on their way, the reported job, Done count, settlement in flight, failed saves in a row, the save-retry timer) became one BulkRecovery object in src/lib/bulk-recovery.ts, whose holds() and countFailedSave() hold the two decisions that read them together.
